card.name: "is recommended" after a monitoring or dose subject
card.fires_on: The word right after "is" that completes a passive statement, mostly "recommended", after a subject such as monitoring of blood glucose or a dose amount. It also fires on "shown" in "is shown in Fig.".

modes.label: Recommended in labels
modes.description: "recommended" ends a clause saying a measure, technique or dose is advised.
modes.example: careful monitoring of blood glucose is<< recommended>> when these agents are co-administered

modes.label: Shown in figure
modes.description: "shown" follows "is" when a diagram is introduced in a paper.
